Category: frontend

get-spec output:
Owner reports weak site performance/SEO and wants a technical-only pass -- no copy, content or visual/design changes. Scope: meta tags per page/game (title, description, canonical, Open Graph, Twitter card), structured data (JSON-LD, e.g. Game or SoftwareApplication schema), a real sitemap.xml (check whether src/app/sitemap.ts and src/app/robots.ts App Router conventions exist -- they likely do not yet -- add if missing), Core Web Vitals and Lighthouse issues (image optimization, render-blocking resources, font loading, hydration cost). Also required: full keyboard accessibility across the whole app -- every interactive element including dropdowns, menus and tabs must be reachable and operable via Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Escape and arrow keys, with visible focus states, correct ARIA roles/labels, and no keyboard traps. Run whatever real auditing is available first (Lighthouse, axe-core, or a manual keyboard walkthrough) to find concrete issues, then fix everything found -- do not guess at problems. Note: public/robots.txt and public/llms.txt already exist but are stale (still list hidden/removed games); they are separate pending tasks, do not rewrite them here. Explicitly out of scope this round: copy changes, visual redesign, content or keyword strategy, backlinks.

11	skills. Two reasons: (1) `superpowers:brainstorming` hard-gates on human approval before any
12	implementation step — incompatible with an unattended pipeline run; (2) both skills are
13	machine-local plugins, not committed to this repo, so referencing them would silently no-op on
14	every cloud routine run (the pipeline's primary execution mode).

Context: frontend card, no override. Scope is app-wide and audit-first: Next 16 metadata per page/game
(`src/app/layout.tsx`, `src/app/[game]/page.tsx` — no `sitemap.ts`/`robots.ts` exist yet), JSON-LD,
Core Web Vitals fixes, and keyboard/ARIA operability for every interactive element (Navigation drawer,
LogInSignUp tabs, dropdowns, ModalHost, 19 GameFrame renderers). `standard` was defensible — frontend
only, no backend, and each individual fix (aria-label, focus-visible, `generateMetadata`) is small.
Decision: `difficulty: hard`, `needsDesignRound: true`, `risk: low`, `engineModel: sonnet`
provisional, `planModel: fable`. The spec is long-and-vague ("audit, then fix everything found"),
introduces new patterns (App Router metadata/sitemap/JSON-LD, roving-tabindex menus/tabs) and spans
ui + games + every renderer; per the model rubric that is a plan defect to fix in the design round,
not an engine upgrade. The round should run the audit (Lighthouse/axe/keyboard walk) and turn the
findings into file-named steps with done-checks. No auth/pipeline/protocol/protected path → risk low.
Consequences: public/robots.txt and public/llms.txt stay untouched (separate cards); `src/app/robots.ts`
must not collide with the static file — the plan must pick one. No visual change: focus states must
use existing tokens. If the audit list is huge, the plan may split into follow-up cards rather than
one mega-diff.
